experiment: Generate twice with the same seed, once with seed+1 and once with a 4 Hz tracker; compare arrays bitwise; recompute the trajectory from x0 and the retained process noise by cumulative sums with the declared dt and evaluate every sensor function on it (hypot and complex angles for speed and heading rate); count reading ticks; check symmetry and positive definiteness of the declared covariances.

angle wrap in the heading-rate model
a generator transition inconsistent with the declared dt

hypothesis: A seeded, stream-separated generator can produce a planar multi-sensor bench whose truth, raw readings, noise draws and declared covariances are exactly reproducible and rate-exact.
mathematical_model: Truth x = (px, py, vx, vy), x_{k+1} = F x_k + w_k with the exact white-noise-acceleration discretization F = [[I, dt I], [0, I]], Q = q [[dt^3/3 I, dt^2/2 I], [dt^2/2 I, dt I]] (dt = 0.05 s, q = 0.05 m^2/s^3). Sensors: camera position (10 Hz, R = [[0.04, 0.012], [0.012, 0.04]] m^2), encoder speed |v| (20 Hz, 0.01 m^2/s^2), IMU heading rate as an integrating gyro wrap(theta_k - theta_{k-1})/dt (20 Hz, 4e-4 rad^2/s^2), tracker position (2 Hz, 0.0025 I m^2).
numerical_result: 0 of 5 arrays differ on regeneration; all differ under seed+1; counts camera 200, encoder 400, imu 400, tracker 40; max composition residual 1.37e-12 against the recomputed trajectory (trajectory difference 7.1e-14); tracker retiming changed 0 other streams.
observation_model: z = h(x) + v with v ~ N(0, R) drawn by Cholesky factors (not SVD) so draws are platform-stable; readings at every positive multiple of each sensor's period.

title: Build a deterministic multi-sensor synthetic bench.
uncertainty: None for the determinism and rate claims (exact). The composition residual is floating-point roundoff of two summation orders. Cross-platform byte identity of the digest is not claimed (libm may differ in the last bit); findings avoid digest values for that reason.
unresolved_assumptions: White-noise acceleration is a modelling choice, not observed vehicle motion.
The heading-rate truth of white-noise-acceleration motion is rough; the IMU stream is kept for completeness but the linear experiments use positions.
Encoder and IMU are nonlinear in the state; no experiment here fuses them.
